findings.text: money/data: apps/api/src/products/fixedCosts.ts PATCH synthetic months=null reuses kind editedAt; a stale kind change that loses LWW can still clear months (stored oneTime, kindEditedAt T5, monthsEditedAt T1, stale kind monthly at T3 -> oneTime with months null, monthly amount 0); reverse also possible. Reconcile kind/months invariant after LWW, with a test (raised from reviewer's non-blocking: it corrupts cost data)
schema.prisma ~L557: ExtraCost doc comment now sits above enum FixedCostKind; move it back
projects/routes.test.ts PATCH body assertion is one long line (style)
schema: migration gives existing projects expectedCupsEditedAt=now while new ones use epoch; a slow phone clock right after deploy loses a cups edit. Same pattern as #13 targetMarginEditedAt

data/money: fixedCosts.ts L176-182, L200-204: a stale kind/months edit 400s the whole PATCH, rolling back newer-winning name/amount edits in the same queued change (breaks R8 per-field LWW). Resolve kind/months inside LWW: months-null only if kind write won; drop incoming months when resulting kind != oneTime; 400 only for self-inconsistent requests; test stale months/kind + winning amount -> 200 with amount applied
fixedCosts.ts L201: forcing months null doesn't bump monthsEditedAt
deploy order: syncCycle.ts:137/148 treats any 404 as project gone; new app vs old API (no /fixed-costs) empties cached products until API deploys. Deploy API before releasing the app
fixedCosts.ts:183: stale rename to a now-taken name 400s the whole PATCH; check name only when its edit wins
fixedCosts.ts:117-123: retried create after another member deleted recreates the item (same as extra costs/products)
